# NCAAB - High Point vs Liberty, 12:00 AM ET Mon Nov 2 (Field of 68 Opening Day Marathon, Rock Hill SC - neutral)

Lines: High Point -6.5 (DraftKings, down from 7.5) / -7.5 (Hard Rock), ML ~-325/+260, total 154.5. Splits (Hard Rock): High Point 57% of spread bets but Liberty +7.5 has 90% of the money; Under has 60% of tickets and 90% of money.

Ratings: kenpom.com cannot be read automatically; Bart Torvik preseason (same tempo-free method) used: High Point #68 (AdjO 114.5, AdjD 101.6, projected 28-4), Liberty #140 (AdjO 106.4, AdjD 105.0).
`kuick_analyst kenpom` (neutral, tempo assumed 68 each): **High Point 75.6, Liberty 67.9** - High Point by 7.6, win 75.6% (Polymarket 75%). HP -6.5 covers 54.1%, -7.5 covers 50.4%. Total is tempo-driven: 143.5 at average tempo, ~156 if both play fast (71) - no reliable total read without KenPom tempo.

Rosters: High Point (31-5 last year) returns Big South POY Cam'Ron Fletcher plus Martinez, Hausen; adds CJ Brown (USF), Jason Rivera-Torres (Monmouth), Isaac Garrett, Curtis Williams Jr. Liberty lost its top six scorers incl. CUSA POY Zach Cleveland; six transfers.

Prediction: High Point 78, Liberty 70. No bet: HP -6.5 is ~52.4% after the 0.58 factor (no edge), big money is on Liberty and moved the line, and early-season ratings are mostly priors. Cappers (Action, Hard Rock, Covers) are all on High Point.
